sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} ribbon seal carried her tag for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Ribbon seals spend most of the year in open water and haul out on sea ice in spring to give birth and moult.
Her farthest point from the start, {max_displacement_km} away, came on {farthest_date}, late in her record.
Before that, her tag went silent for {longest_gap_days}.
Why the tag went quiet isn't recorded. The map shows the gap as a dashed line, not a guessed route.
